title: Battelle studied Roswell lightweight metals

tellings.quote: and there there's research to suggest that Battel also studied the like really lightweight metals out of the 1947 Roswell crash.

plain: An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb says there is research suggesting that the Battelle Memorial Institute, a private research organisation, studied very lightweight metals taken from the crash near Roswell, New Mexico, in 1947, where some say an unknown craft came down. He points to records tied to something called Project Stork, which he dates to 1947 to 1949. If true, it would mean private scientists were handed crash material to study.
